newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares mixed to weak in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares mixed to weak in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares were mixed to weak on another round of profit-taking on Thursday, but brokers maintained the bourse outlook remained generally bullish on expectations the economy would post high growth next year.
"Every now and then, the market will weaken because some investors think it's time to cash in or diversify but the general character is one of firmness," one broker said.

"The view is that we will get rains and the economy, despite its other problems, will grow significantly," he said of the agriculture-driven country whose gross domestic product (GDP) in 1997 is seen at around seven percent.

On Thursday, the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange's main industrial index fell 14.41 points to 6,777.17 following losses in some key counters, including hotel chain Zimsun, financial house udc and clothing group Edgars, which traded 10, five and 150 cents down respectively at 380, 220 and 2,750.
Minings were quiet and easier in light trade, but a 25-cent rise in coal producer Wankie at 340 helped the seven-share mining index edge up 2.94 points to 1,207.35.
